mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE reserved_at >= CURDATE() AND reserved_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND status <> 'CANCELLED') AS todayReservations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members WHERE status='ACTIVE') AS registeredMembers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM golf_courses WHERE status='OPEN') AS operatingCourses, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations WHERE status='PENDING') AS pendingReservations

SELECT r.reservation_no AS reservationNo,m.name AS memberName,c.name AS courseName,r.reserved_at AS reservedAt,r.status AS status FROM reservations r JOIN members m ON m.id=r.member_id JOIN golf_courses c ON c.id=r.course_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
